subject: Need more friends for Burnout Revenge
author: sparker599
body:
I'd really like to play some BO:R before it goes offline - getting signature takedowns and achievements and just having fun. For anyone who wants to play with me, my GT is sparker600. I have only 2 or 3 friends who play BO:R regularly right now.
How many people are wanting to take part in this meetup?
